title: Gravel Wheel Shootout - Episode 2 - Zipp XPLR VS Hunt VS Elite VS Secret

takeaways.text: Two timed runs each on a roughly 10-minute gravel segment with identical 2.1 in tires: an unnamed wheel was fastest, then Zipp 303 XPLR, then Hunt 40 Limitless, with the Elitewheels Drive G36 essentially tied with the Hunt (Zipp about 4 s ahead of the Drive G36).
The shop testers found the G36 one of the most compliant gravel wheels they had ridden and called it a strong budget choice; it is narrower and shallower than the others tested.
The Drive G36 pair weighed about 1,325 g, 3 g less than the carbon-spoked Hunt; internal width is 25 mm.

disclosure: Published by a bicycle shop that links its own store; how the test wheels were obtained is not stated.
summary: Shop staff compare the Elite Drive G36 with Zipp 303 XPLR, Hunt 40 Limitless and Secret Wheels gravel wheelsets. It is comparative opinion, not a laboratory test.
